MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.LEGAL_DOMAIN: m is an integer with 0<=m<=6; for each core vertex u, 0<=b_u<=r_u; sum_u(r_u-b_u)=2m.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.CCZ_COUNTING_UNIT: A candidate is a core-complement edge tagged by one of the six zero vertices; the loss term A bounds candidates that do not certify a CCZ instance.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.CCZ_NO_DOUBLE_COUNTING: Each counted CCZ instance has a unique core-complement edge and zero-vertex tag, so one candidate contributes at most once.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.INTEGER_CAPACITY_LOSS: A_FULL=sum_u r_u(1+2r_u)=94. If x=r_u-b_u units are removed, the loss is x(1+3r_u-x): one removed unit from capacity 1 costs 3, while x removed units from capacity 5 cost x(16-x). Since 2m<=12<13, the least loss for 2m integer units removes only capacity-1 units, so A<=94-6m.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.GOODMAN_IDENTITY_INFERENCE: Every listed integer case gives I_CCZ>=56; with T+I=292, Goodman's identity implies T<=236.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.BONF64_SUPPORT_LINEARITY: The 22 triple supports form a linear 3-uniform hypergraph. Their 66 ticket-pair incidences are distinct and disjoint from the 27 double-support pairs, giving 93 overlap-edge classes.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.S4_LOWER_BOUND_PROOF: For the 20 triple-support degrees t_i with sum 66, the balanced integer allocation has sum(t_i^2)=222. If S4 were zero, the cross-incidence lower bound 4*66+222=486 across 22*17=374 core/outside pairs forces at least 112 pairs with two incidences. Those pairs inject into 66 core edges: two outside common neighbors on one core edge would make a contributing quartet. This contradiction gives a contributing quartet, and the pinned local table's smallest positive count is 112, hence S4>=112P for the P distinct pair certificates.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.P_DEFINITION: P=sum_{j=1}^{93} binom(q_j,2), where q_j are the excess noncore-triangle incidences assigned to the 93 distinct overlap-edge classes and sum_j q_j=3T-66.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.P_NO_DOUBLE_COUNTING: Each unordered pair counted by binom(q_j,2) belongs to one unique overlap-edge class; linearity prevents a support pair from appearing in two classes. The counted pair certificates are credited once in S4.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.WINNER_MULTIPLICITY_PROOF: At most seven tickets can win on one outcome: select three of the seven hit labels from each winner; the resulting triples are pairwise linear, so they use distinct pairs and number at most binom(7,2)/binom(3,2)=7.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.BONFERRONI_UNION_PROOF: For multiplicity r<=3, the third-order Bonferroni excess over the union indicator is zero. For 4<=r<=7 it is at least (4/7)*binom(r,4). Summing and using S4>=112P gives Union<=B3-(4/7)*112P=B3-64P.
MATHEMATICAL_PROOF.ENDPOINT_MONOTONICITY_PROOF: For each legal T step, B3 increases by 11872. In this range 3T-66<=642, so Phi93(n+3)-Phi93(n)<=18; therefore U64 increases by at least 11872-64*18=10720 at every step. Its maximum is the T=236 endpoint.
